scripts.build: npm run build:css && python scripts/build_site.py && pagefind --site dist && python scripts/validate_site.py && node scripts/validate_search.mjs
scripts.build:preview: npm run build:css && python scripts/build_site.py --preview && pagefind --site dist-preview && python scripts/validate_site.py --preview && node scripts/validate_search.mjs --preview
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:preview && python scripts/package_release.py
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build:preview && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.preview.jsonc
